title.en: Chapter 17 — The Dog in the Night

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: قال هولمز للمفتش: انتبه لتصرف الكلب هديك الليلة.
sentences.en: Holmes said to the inspector: note the dog’s behaviour that night.

sentences.ar: قال لستراد: الكلب ما عمل إشي هديك الليلة.
sentences.en: Lestrade said: the dog did nothing that night.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: وهاي بالزبط الشغلة الغريبة.
sentences.en: Holmes said: and that is exactly the curious thing.

sentences.ar: في كلب بالإسطبل، وما نبح على اللي أخذ الحصان.
sentences.en: There is a dog in the stable, and it did not bark at whoever took the horse.
Which means the dog knew him well.

sentences.ar: يعني اللي أخذ الحصان من أهل البيت.
sentences.en: Which means whoever took the horse was of the household.
